My Price is My Life | Setting Sail with Whistleblower Jodi O’Malley and James O’Keefe Episode #4

Whistleblower Jodi O’Malley comes aboard the Lucky Charm III to share what her life’s been like since she heroically exposed how the federal government was handling (and allegedly hiding) adverse reactions to the COVID-19 vaccine.

In 2021, Jodi was a nurse at the Phoenix Indian Medical Center, a facility under the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). She tells James how the Holy Spirit prompted her to hit “record” while her concerned colleagues, including physicians, were discussing patients they believed were suffering adverse effects from the vaccine, reactions that weren't being formally reported. Thus, igniting Jodi’s ongoing advocacy in nursing.

Jodi also shares other challenging moments in her life that strengthened her faith and trust in God, leading her to the work and mission she’s tackling now.

➡️ Hong Kong man loses HK$13 million in fake crypto investment app scam 

🌐 A Hong Kong man in his 70s has lost more than HK$13 million ($1.67 million) after a self-described cryptocurrency investment expert contacted him through WhatsApp and directed him to a fake trading app. The latest case began when the elderly man received an unsolicited WhatsApp message from someone claiming to be a cryptocurrency investment expert from Singapore. The person introduced him to what was presented as a crypto platform offering favorable exchange rates, low fees and withdrawals at any time.

‼️ Following the instructions he received, the man opened a cryptocurrency wallet and purchased Tether (USDT) and Ethereum (ETH). He was then told to download an investment application supplied by the scammer and transfer the cryptocurrency to designated wallet addresses as investment capital.

📣 Seeing his account balance rise inside the app, the victim became less suspicious and continued sending more cryptocurrency to the wallets provided by the scammer. The fraud only became clear when he tried to withdraw his funds and was repeatedly prevented from doing so under different pretexts. By the time the victim realized the investment platform was fraudulent, his losses had exceeded HK$13 million.

⚡️ Pezeshkian: Iran ready to resolve issues with neighbors through diplomacy

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says Iran is ready to resolve differences with its neighbors through dialogue and mutual respect.

President Pezeshkian made the remarks in a meeting with Bafel Talabani, head of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK) of Iraq, in Tehran on Wednesday.
​
The Iranian president said the relationship between Iran and the Kurdistan Region is rooted in geographical proximity and shared historical, ethnic and cultural ties.
​
President Pezeshkian called for greater regional cooperation, saying countries share deep and longstanding connections. He said these common bonds should be used to advance cooperation, stability and development.
​
The president also said external efforts to create divisions and conflict in the region should be addressed through greater cooperation and dialogue. He said Iran was prepared to resolve issues with neighboring parties through mutual understanding and respect, while expecting all sides to observe good-neighborly principles and avoid excessive demands and improper conduct.
​
Iranians consider Muslims brothers and believe regional issues can be resolved through cooperation, dialogue, fairness and justice, President Pezeshkian said. He added that mutual respect could help create a region marked by peace, development, progress and solidarity.
​
He further called for increased travel, interaction and exchanges between Iran and the Kurdistan Region. He also highlighted the potential for cooperation in investment, science and academia, politics, the economy and culture.
​
The president emphasized closer ties between border provinces, saying trade, economic exchanges and other cooperation could contribute to development in border areas. He also referred to his administration’s approach of using the capabilities of different ethnic and religious communities based on merit and ability.
​
Talabani, for his part, described Iran as a key friend and partner of Iraq’s Kurdistan Region and said his party supports expanding bilateral cooperation between Iran and the Kurdistan Region.
​
Addressing border security, Talabani said his side was making every effort to preserve Iran’s security from the Kurdistan Region’s borders. He also referred to the security agreement between Iran and Iraq, saying efforts would continue under the agreement to move anti-Iran groups away from areas along Iran’s borders and strengthen security and stability.
​
Talabani added that he had brought an economic team to Iran to help address existing needs and increase trade and economic cooperation between the two sides.

Grok has learned to change the text on an image without rebuilding it from scratch.

You upload a poster, invitation, poster, or advertising layout and write: replace this inscription. The background, faces, light, and composition remain. Only the text changes.

Previously, any typo in "24 сентября" meant a new generator and roulette with a face on the poster. Now, editing is closer to a layer in Photoshop than to "draw it again".

The tool is still in beta. xAI collects feedback, while letters in complex fonts and small sizes can still float.

For web and print, this is not magic. It's minus ten rounds of "almost there, but the date is wrong".
